title: I have a few Questions regarding a game idea I have in mind but I don't have the technical knowledge how or the man power to build
author: GGAIGame
selftext:
So in theory I was wondering if it's even remotely possible to build the skeleton or even a base game version of a game that is usable on both mobile and PC using unreal engine while also using entirely open source and publicly available game data and implement entirely AI generated materials and even code in an almost entirely automated process?
I've spent 2 days refining the idea for the game with as many different AI models as possible to try and create some sense of core mechanics and stuff based entirely off a random idea given by chat Gpt and got it to write me an unreal file but Im unsure how far this process can possibly be taken? Any and all info and help is greatly appreciated

comments.author: lplegacy
comments.body: Can you ask ChatGPT to explain exactly what you're asking us

comments.body: Vibe coding really has shined a light on the non technical folks with schizophrenia
